headline: Still awaiting trade, Connor Hellebuyck could rejoin Jets when suspension ends
take:
Per ESPN, Winnipeg is still waiting on a possible trade of Connor Hellebuyck, a former NHL MVP and three-time Vezina Trophy winner. Players are preparing for difficult conversations if he rejoins the Jets next week, when his suspension is expected to end.

The numbers show why the Jets can't take this lightly. Winnipeg sits at 4-2-2 for 10 points through eight games, but the process has been shakier than the record. The Jets have 46.6% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) overall and 46% at five-on-five, so they are being outchanced more often than not. Their goals total is 0.9 below what their chances would suggest, and the goaltending has been the one thing holding the results together, with 3.3 goals saved above expected so far this season. That is a small sample, and the site's goalie table has no Hellebuyck line to separate his share of that from the rest of the crew. Still, a team that is losing the chance battle leans heavily on whoever is in net. If Hellebuyck leaves, that cushion goes with him, and a 46% five-on-five share leaves little room for the record to hold.
